description: Use this when someone wants a cycling, running or walking route that starts and finishes at the same place, with a target distance or duration and optional climbing and scenery preferences, or a trip from a start to a destination, split into days (give destination, or dest_lng and dest_lat; distance or duration is then the longest day). Do not use it for driving. Shows the routes on a map where the host supports it, and always returns a link that opens the same request in Remap. Give either start (place text such as "Tempelhofer Feld, Berlin") or lng and lat, never both. When the person has not said where, call generate_routes without a start: the map asks for the person’s location and generates routes from there.

climbing.description: flat avoids hills, balanced neither seeks nor avoids them, hilly looks for climbs.

dest_lat.description: Destination latitude in degrees, when the destination is known as a coordinate.

dest_lng.description: Destination longitude in degrees, when the destination is known as a coordinate.

destination.description: Where a trip ends, as place text. With a destination Remap plans a trip from the start to it, split into days, and climbing and scenery do not apply.

distance.description: Target distance of the whole route; for a trip to a destination, the longest day.

distance_unit.description: Unit of distance: km or mi. Defaults to km.

duration_minutes.description: Target duration in minutes, instead of a distance; for a trip, the longest day.

environments.description: Scenery to favour where the area has it. forest: through forest; parks: through parks and nature reserves; waterside: along rivers, canals and lakes; coast: along the coastline; climbs: over hills worth climbing; quiet_streets: through calm residential streets and lanes; long_stretches: along long, quiet, uninterrupted stretches; cycle_routes: following signed cycle routes (cycling only).

lat.description: Start latitude in degrees, when the start is known as a coordinate.

lng.description: Start longitude in degrees, when the start is known as a coordinate.

sport.description: The activity. Walking generates foot routes at walking pace.

start.description: Where the route starts and finishes, as place text (a town, park, street or address).

name: generate_routes
title: Generate routes
